_comment: Source catalogue for Cedar Point. Official listings are JS-rendered; heights sidecar is the ground truth until a cache is built. Fetch with npm run venues:research -- cedar-point --fetch.

sources.used_for: Park geometry, coasters, paths, buildings, campground pitches, and the venue boundary.
Height requirements and attraction names for the 2026 season.
Ride labels, food, restrooms, walking paths and queue entrances when georeferenced (illustrated handout — TPS).

research.note: LLM may propose aliases and height candidates from official HTML; code decides. Never invents coordinates.
